articles.summary: Buen Fin, Black Friday and the holidays are when you send the most messages. Boom templates now add UTM tags to their buttons, so every visit reaches your analytics with its campaign and you know what to repeat.
articles.title: Peak season: measure which WhatsApp campaign sells, then double down

articles.summary: If you send email on behalf of many merchants, each one wants to see their own brand. Now one journey and one template go out in each merchant's logo and colors. Here's how it works.
articles.title: White-label? We've got you: every email in your merchant's logo and colors

articles.summary: Some customer data shouldn't reach an AI agent or every teammate. You can now mark it hidden and keep using it. Here is how it works.
articles.title: Hide sensitive data from your AI agents and your team

articles.summary: One journey for customers in several countries. The Cases node splits people by timezone and by language, so everyone gets the right template at the right time.
articles.title: A message at each customer's 9:00, in their language

articles.summary: Journeys used to run once per person, so a second invoice was dropped and one payment could stop every reminder. Now a journey can run once per invoice, started and stopped by the events you send.
articles.title: One customer, three invoices, three journeys

articles.summary: A test, a sign-up or a request on your own page. Every response goes straight into your CDP and can enroll the person in a customer journey within seconds.
articles.title: Forms on your site that start customer journeys

articles.summary: Some conversations you don't want a bot to answer, but you still want to answer them faster. Smart Reply drafts the next message in your inbox and you edit it and send it. Here is how it works.
articles.title: The agent writes the reply, you decide if it goes

articles.summary: Some conversations are faster to solve by talking. Your team can now call a customer on WhatsApp from the same conversation. Here is how to turn it on and how it works.
articles.title: How to turn on WhatsApp calling in your shared inbox (early access)
